title: Drop forwardRef and take ref as a prop
summary: The app is on React 19 now, so TextField loses its forwardRef wrapper and takes ref like any other prop.

turns.user: on react 19 now. heard forwardRef isnt needed anymore, can we drop it from TextField

assistant.body: Sure! In React 19 a function component receives ref as a regular prop, so the forwardRef boilerplate can go. ComponentProps<'input'> already includes ref, so destructure it and hand it to the input. LoginForm keeps passing ref={emailRef} exactly as before.

turns.user: tsc now fails in LoginForm on the useRef<number>() line. Expected 1 arguments, but got 0

assistant.body: Note: that one is unrelated to forwardRef. The React 19 types make the initial value of useRef required. The timer id does not exist yet, so pass undefined explicitly.
